title: Practice 4: Prepositional endings: nouns, adjectives, pronouns

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Мистер Смит сбился с пути в ___ (густой) тумане.
exercises.prompt: Mr Smith lost his way in the dense fog.
exercises.why: «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 46.
